newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Colombia peso falls, markets close for Christmas.
newsitem.headline: Colombia peso falls, markets close for Christmas.

text.p: Colombia's peso fell 1.04 to 1.002.49 as the central bank stepped in to prop up the greenback on the last day of trading before Christmas, interbank traders said Monday.
Dealers were unable to give an estimate of the extent of the central bank intervention, which nevertheless failed to lift the dollar off the floor of the daily floating exchange rate band.
"The truth is that there's a lot of excess dollars in the market, made worse by today's entry of private sector petrodollars," one trader said.
Dealers reported 99 trades worth a total $147 million. The peso hit an intraday low of 1,002.59 and an intraday high of 1,002.48.
There will be no currency trading Tuesday or Wednesday for Christmas. Operations resume Thursday.
